name: Operational Dashboard
description: Pipeline health, data quality, and operational metrics

native.query: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as health_score FROM analytics._pipeline_log WHERE start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as dq_score FROM analytics._data_quality_log WHERE run_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rows_processed), 0) as total_rows FROM analytics._pipeline_log WHERE start_time::DATE = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) as failures FROM analytics._pipeline_log WHERE status = 'failed' AND start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT dag_id, dag_run_id, start_time, end_time, duration_seconds, status, rows_processed, COALESCE(error_message, '-') as error FROM analytics._pipeline_log WHERE start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT dataset_name, SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passed_checks, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_checks FROM analytics._data_quality_log WHERE run_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY dataset_name ORDER BY dataset_name

SELECT start_time::DATE as date, dag_id, AVG(duration_seconds) as avg_duration FROM analytics._pipeline_log WHERE start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days' AND status = 'success' GROUP BY start_time::DATE, dag_id ORDER BY date

SELECT 'fact_transactions' as table_name, MAX(_loaded_at) as last_updated, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MAX(_loaded_at)) as hours_old FROM analytics.fact_transactions UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_customer_sessions', MAX(_loaded_at), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MAX(_loaded_at)) FROM analytics.fact_customer_sessions UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_customers', MAX(updated_at), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MAX(updated_at)) FROM analytics.dim_customers

SELECT run_timestamp, dataset_name, check_name, severity, message, affected_rows FROM analytics._data_quality_log WHERE NOT passed AND run_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
